maddeler.e:
تقتبلون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَبِلُونَ (taqtabilūna) /taq.ta.bi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# تُقْتَبَلُونَ (tuqtabalūna) /tuq.ta.ba.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
